script_parts.opening: Namaste, Woodspace Office Furniture se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se call kar raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account kaafi strong tha pehle, lekin last 30 days mein sirf 1 active day record hua hai aur Business Leads bilkul zero ho gayi hain — 100% drop — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ye sudden change jo aaya hai — kya koi specific reason tha, jaise team change, busy season, ya platform pe koi issue aaya tha jis wajah se login aur engagement band ho gayi? Kyunki 4 mahine pehle activity kaafi achi thi, phir ek dum cliff aa gayi.
script_parts.value_demo: Dekhiye ji, aapka Reply Rate abhi bhi 70% hai — matlab jab bhi lead aati hai, aap respond karte ho — ye ek strong signal hai. Problem ye hai ki last month BL velocity -100% ho gayi, matlab naye leads aa hi nahi rahe. Agar hum sirf catalog quality score — jo abhi 71 hai, 75 se neeche — thoda improve kar dein, toh platform aapka listing zyada buyers ko dikhana shuru kar deta hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur dekhte hain ki kaun se 2-3 products hain jinpe images ya description weak hai, unhe turant update karte hain — 10 minute ka kaam hai, CQS 71 se 75+ le jaayenge aaj hi.
script_parts.close: Bas ek cheez chahiye aapse — agle 7 din mein sirf teen baar login karein aur jo updates hum aaj karte hain unhe confirm kar lein. Koi bada commitment nahi, bas platform ko signal dena hai ki account active hai — theek hai ji?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Woodspace Office Furniture? This is calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account was performing well earlier, but in the last 30 days there's been only 1 active day recorded and Business Leads have dropped 100% month-on-month, so I felt it was important to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I can see this was a sudden drop — your activity was quite strong about 4 months ago and then it fell off a cliff. Was there a specific reason for this change — a team reshuffle, a busy period offline, or maybe some issue you faced on the platform that made logging in difficult?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's what's interesting — your Reply Rate is still 70%, which means whenever a lead does come in, you're responding. The problem is the lead pipeline itself has dried up because your Catalog Quality Score is 71, just below the 75 threshold where IndiaMART's algorithm starts pushing listings more actively to buyers in the office furniture demand pool.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll identify 2-3 product listings where images or descriptions are weak, and update them together. It's a 10-minute fix that can push your CQS from 71 to 75+ today itself.
script_parts_en.close: All I'm asking for is one small commitment — log in at least 3 times over the next 7 days and confirm the updates we make today are live. No big ask, just enough activity to signal to the platform that your account is back — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
